results.title: The Go Programming Language
results.content: Go is an open source programming language supported by Google with built-in concurrency and a robust standard library.

results.title: Go Tutorial - W3Schools
results.content: Learn Go programming with examples. Go is a statically typed, compiled language designed at Google. Posted 3 hours ago by community.

results.content: Go by Example is a hands-on introduction to Go using annotated example programs. Published yesterday by maintainers.

results.content: Download Go binaries for your platform. The latest release includes security updates and performance improvements.

results.content: Effective Go gives tips for writing clear, idiomatic Go code. If you're new to Go, read the tutorial and then come back here.

results.title: A Tour of Go
results.content: An interactive introduction to Go. Learn the basics of Go through examples. 2 days ago we added new concurrency examples.

results.title: Go Modules Reference - golang.org
results.content: A module is a collection of related Go packages that are versioned together as a single unit. Modules record precise dependency requirements.

results.title: GitHub - golang/go
results.content: The Go programming language source repository. Contribute to golang/go development by creating an account on GitHub.

results.title: Go (programming language) - Wikipedia
results.content: Go is a statically typed, compiled high-level programming language designed at Google by Robert Griesemer, Rob Pike, and Ken Thompson.

results.title: Learn Go in Y Minutes
results.content: Go was created out of the need to get work done. It's a pragmatic language that lets you write code quickly and efficiently.

answers.answer: Go is a statically typed, compiled programming language designed at Google by Robert Griesemer, Rob Pike, and Ken Thompson. It provides garbage collection, CSP-style concurrency, and structural typing. More at Wikipedia
